attributes.name: Blessing of Shizuru
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Recharge this card to add 1 die to any check that invokes the Melee or Ranged trait, or 2 dice if it is your check.

Discard this card to explore your location. 

After you play this card, if the top card if the blessings discard pile lists Strength in its check to acquire, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
